world.title: Trump says every adult American would get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
world.description: Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.

world.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
world.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

world.title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry

world.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
world.description: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.

world.title: Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on $2,000 first folding iPhone
world.description: Apple showed off at an event the first major design change to the iPhone in almost 20 years.

world.title: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
world.description: The US tech giant says the €13bn data centre project will create tens of thousands of jobs.

world.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes

world.title: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief

world.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes

world.title: N Korea has built two-storey uranium enrichment facility, says watchdog
world.description: The International Atomic Energy Agency's says the facility is cause for "serious concern".

world.title: Colombia's new president loosens gun control rules
world.description: President Abelardo de la Espriella has lifted a decade-long suspension on permits to carry legal firearms.

US.title: A pilot of the Amazon cargo plane in Miami crash warned it was coming in too fast

US.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
US.description: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

US.title: Conductor Julian Wachner receives suspended sentence for possession of child sex abuse material
US.description: The formerly prominent, widely recorded conductor was sentenced Wednesday to nearly six years of probation for five counts of possession of child sex abuse material in Indianapolis.

US.title: Fold the phone: Apple's new CEO unveils a foldable iPhone
US.description: New Apple CEO John Ternus announces the iPhone Duo, which folds like a passport and is the most radical iPhone design update in nearly 20 years.

US.title: Greetings from Paris, where the 2024 Olympics balloon rises again
US.description: The floating Olympic cauldron, held aloft by a giant glowing balloon, is still making regular appearances two years after the 2024 Paris Games, showing up all summer long in the nighttime Paris sky.

US.title: A new Anthropic model seeks to test how AI could impact the U.S. economy
US.description: Will artificial intelligence nibble around the edges of the economy or upend it altogether? A new, interactive model from Anthropic lets people tests their assumptions.

US.title: Whatever happened to the measles outbreak that shocked a country this year?
US.description: Bangladesh has seen over 50,000 confirmed or suspected cases of measles this year. The death toll among children just surpassed 1,000. How are officials trying to bring the outbreak under control?

US.title: Trump officials propose sweeping changes to the census that would reshape voting maps
